note: Single source of truth for Keel's model tiers. The agents' frontmatter must match (CI checks it). To change a tier for one project without editing the plugin, set "tiers" in .keel/config.json in that project (or run /keel:settings); /keel:delegate passes the model explicitly. The critic is a thinking task, so it has its own tier instead of inheriting the lead's. Which model a task gets, per task, is decided by /keel:route (the ladder in defaults.json).
